Class Animator

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.animation.Animator
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class Animator extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Per-element timeline owner. All operations belong to the target's client/UI thread. Replacement cancels older overlapping tracks; no global animation state or worker threads are used.
